summary: Mobile Infrastructure Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the declaration of routine monthly dividends on its Series A Preferred Stock at $4.791 per share and Series 1 Preferred Stock at $4.583 per share, payable on or about September 14, 2026. Record dates are August 30 and August 24, 2026, respectively. The board retains discretion over future dividends. This is an ordinary dividend announcement, not a special situation, capital return event, or other transformative transaction. No deal terms apply, and there is no risk-arbitrage angle.
